title: Atthara Bhaiyo ki Bahen Qaid Hui Hai
body:
Atthara bhaiyo ki behan qaid huwi hai, pardes me Zainab pa qayamat ki ghadi hai.
1.Humraha muhafiz the amari thi rida thi, yasrib se basadd shaan chali jiski sawari, be aasra mqatal se wohi bibi chali hai.
<<MINI>>
Atthara bhaiyo..................................
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Rota hai tadap ta hai dil e Abid e muztar, girjaata hai sar ghazi ka naize se zami par, rassi jo nabi zaadi ke haathau me bandhi hai.
<<MINI>>
Atthara bhaiyo..................................
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Imdad ko shahzadi bhala kisko pukare, islam pe qurbaan huwe saare sahare, pardes me majboor bohat binte Ali hai.
<<MINI>>
Atthara bhaiyo...................................
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Wo jisko andhere ne bhi dekha na khule sar, laye hai usey din ke ujale me sitamgar, chadar bhi nahi sar pe gareebul watani hai.
<<MINI>>
Atthara bhaiyo....................................
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Jab shumr Sakina ko lagata hai tamache, uswaqt sada deti hai Zainab yahi roke, zalim merei bachi bade nazau ki pali hai.
<<MINI>>
Atthara bhaiyo....................................
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Shehzadiyaa har gaam pe kehti hai tadap kar, hum aale mohd haii yun barsao na patther, aur saare sitamgaarau ke hotau pe hasi hai.
<<MINI>>
Atthara bhaiyo...................................
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Darbar me ek aur qayamat huwi barpa, dil dooz e nazara tha jo Zainab ne hai dekha, bhai ka sar hai aur sitamger ki chadi hai.
<<MINI>>
Atthara bhaiyo.....................................
